features.statement: For every binary input pair i_a, i_b in {0,1}, after applying the pair and allowing 1 ns for settling, o_sum equals i_a XOR i_b and o_carry equals i_a AND i_b.
features.scope: The half_adder top-level outputs for the four two-state input combinations only; outputs are sampled 1 ns after each input pair is applied.

rules.statement: For each binary pair (i_a, i_b), sampled 1 ns after application, o_sum equals i_a XOR i_b and o_carry equals i_a AND i_b.
preconditions: Both scalar inputs are driven with 0 or 1.
Outputs are sampled 1 ns after applying each pair.

unknowns: The exact delta-cycle update count and latency were not measured; this campaign samples outputs 1 ns after applying each binary input pair.
